result.document_summary: A mid-document excerpt of the San Diego Municipal Code (Chapter 3) containing the Grocery Pricing Transparency Ordinance (digital discounts) and the Hospitality Minimum Wage Ordinance, neither of which concerns rental housing.
result.notes: The page URL and title refer to San Diego's ban on algorithmic rent price-fixing (Division 11, SDMC 	s 98.1103), but this part of the document only contains unrelated Chapter 3 material: the minimum wage 'No Effect on Higher Wages' section, the Grocery Pricing Transparency Ordinance (Art. 11), and the Hospitality Minimum Wage Ordinance (Art. 12). None of it addresses rent increase limits, just-cause eviction, security deposits, screening fees, screening restrictions, or algorithmic rent setting, so no rules are extracted. The actual algorithmic-device prohibition text (SDMC 	s 98.1103) may appear in another part of the document.
